newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Nov CPI rises 4.8 pct yr/yr - govt.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Nov CPI rises 4.8 pct yr/yr - govt.

text.p: South Korea's consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.8 percent year-on-year in November, compared with a 4.3 percent rise a year earlier, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said on Friday.
A ministry statement said the consumer price index fell month-to-month because vegetable prices decreased sharply as a result of good harvest.
South Korea has targetted to cap the consumer price index growth for all of this year below 4.5 percent. The CPI was up 4.3 percent from the end of 1995, it said.
Prices of food and beverage products rose 3.2 percent year-on-year in November, compared with a 1.8 percent gain a year earlier.
Prices in the non-food sectors grew 5.6 percent in November, compared with a 5.5 percent rise in November 1995.
